description: Use this when asked whether a service delivered what was promised or whether cited pages contain the quoted text. Pass `citations`, or a service `url` (+ `checks`, the `result` you got), or `claims` with `observations`. Returns a result per item and a receipt. Free, no account; records a GAIP receipt only. Inputs must be public and non-personal.

checks.description: Optional (delivery): what a good response is, e.g. [{"id": "http_status_in", "allowed": [200]}, {"id": "json_parses"}]. Default: HTTP 200 and a non-empty body.

allowed.description: http_status_in: the acceptable HTTP statuses, e.g. [200].

id.description: http_status_in (allowed), content_type_is (value), non_empty, json_parses, json_required_keys (keys), json_path_equals (path, value), max_latency_ms (limit), max_bytes (limit), text_contains (value), regex (pattern).

keys.description: json_required_keys: top-level or dotted keys that must exist, e.g. ["a.b"].

path.description: json_path_equals: dotted path, list items by index, e.g. items.0.id.

pattern.description: regex: bounded pattern searched in the body; no nested quantifiers.

value.description: content_type_is: media type, e.g. application/json; text_contains: case-sensitive text; json_path_equals: the expected value (GAIP also accepts a number, boolean, null, array or object).

citations.description: Citations to check: each {url, quote?} or just a URL. GAIP fetches each page once (robots.txt respected) and looks for the quote.

claims.description: Claims to record about `url`: each a sentence or {id, text}. Each is compared with the `observations` you supply; without them it stays UNTESTED.

continuity_handle.description: Optional: the continuity_handle from an earlier GAIP result; links this call to your earlier ones (needed to see or remove your watches later).

metadata.description: Optional (claims): the published agent card, MCP or OpenAPI document.

observations.description: Optional (claims): what you saw, each {claim_id, result: PASS|FAIL, detail}.

result.description: Optional (delivery): the response you received. Omitted: GAIP fetches the service URL now (public replay).

terms_id.description: Optional (delivery): terms_id from an earlier registration, instead of url.

url.description: Claims: the agent or supplier they are about. Delivery: the public https service URL that should deliver.

verbose.description: Optional: true returns the full result with every underlying field. Default: a short answer.

name: gaip_verify
title: Verify a delivery or citations
